They now pass with admitted work carried into fresh turns, while forged and unknown owners are still rejected.

MEDIUM-2’s completely streamless case cannot pass the current budget guards. I added a witness that removes the owner entry from a live stream; it reproduced the stall and now passes with the fallback. The architecture gate also covers both missing modules. All 13 mutation checks passed.The final gates passed on `7acacf17`: typecheck, build, and both full suites, each with 9,611 passed, 0 failed, and 63 skipped. The focused suite passed all 237 tests, and all 13 mutation checks passed. Only the assigned findings were changed; LOW-4 through LOW-7 remain deferred.
